purpose: L12 Graph teaching diagrams, not execution evidence

prompts.name: 01-graph-anatomy
prompts.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a high-resolution Chinese educational diagram for an adult Graph workflow lecture. Wide 3:2 composition, warm ivory background #F7F5F0, dark navy typography, teal active paths, amber waiting, restrained red rejection. Flat precise editorial infographic, large legible Chinese labels, orthogonal arrows with unambiguous arrowheads, no decoration, no robot, no tiny captions, no watermark. Only depict the requested relationships, all text exactly as supplied. This is a teaching design, not software screenshot. Graph 的五个组成部分。Show a central simple development→test sequence with a conditional split after test, one path to 等待审核 and one to 返工. Label development node 节点：执行动作; directed edge 边：允许去向; test split 条件：依据结果选择. Below show a single shared document with label 共享状态 and entries 当前节点 / 候选版本 / 报告 / 轮数. Below/right show a clearly named 执行器 with brief sequence 读取状态、调用动作、选择下一步. Distinguish executable process arrows from dashed data reads. Headline Graph 怎样运行. Do not depict approval as automatically completing.

Three separated conceptual sections with precise miniature schematics: Loop a bounded cycle 执行 检查 修订 with 停止条件; Subagents two independent tasks 测试补全 and 风险审查 joining 整合复验; Graph nodes 开发 检查 等待审核 with branch 返工 and terminal 停止. Large short captions Loop：失败后怎样重做; Subagents：独立工作怎样分派; Graph：依赖与决定怎样交接. Use exact three labels, no claims of auto intelligence.
